title: The Duke, Alice, and Reuniting with Mom
overview: The Duke, Alice, Cuff, and Zain spend some time at the wizardry school. Meanwhile, Daleth finds someone rather unexpected in the Underworld and takes them to the Duke's mansion.

title: The Duke, Alice, and the Mysterious Clone
overview: Sharon, having been freed from her curse, reunites with her former friends and acquaintances. Unbeknownst to her, Sade hid within her magical clones, bent on attacking anyone who threatens her plans.

title: The Duke, Alice, and Mother and Mother
overview: The Duke catches a cold, and Alice's mother reunites with the Duke's mother after years of separation.

title: The Duke, Alice, and Sade's Love
overview: The Duke and Alice get a very unexpected pair of visitors at the mansion.

title: Dance Party (1)
overview: The Duke and Alice visit the family mansion, where a fancy ball is about to take place.

title: Dance Party (2)
overview: Daleth tells Walter that she wants to become human, and Nico arrives to tell the group that final preparations are complete.

title: Coming Together
overview: The Duke enjoys his last few days before going back into the past to meet Sade.

title: Persuasion
overview: The Duke and his friends go back into the past and try to persuade Sade to break the curse.

title: Loneliness and Uncertainty
overview: The battle with Sade begins in earnest as Zain tries to persuade her to come to the present with them.

title: Victor's Grandson, Sharon's Daughter
overview: Alice goes inside Sade to help heal her loneliness.

title: Friends, a Broken Curse, and Then...
overview: The battle with Sade ends as Alice decides what decision she'll make about her future.

title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
overview: With the curse broken, the Duke, Alice, and everyone else move on to the next stage of their lives.
